whyNotes.gen_sg:
hrad-type · genitive sg → -u (hradu)
Fleeting e drops (-ek/-ec): dárek → dárku
whyNotes.dat_sg:
hrad-type · dative sg → -u (hradu)
Fleeting e drops: dárek → dárku
whyNotes.acc_sg:
hrad-type · accusative sg → same as nominative (hrad)
Note: inanimate → acc = nom
whyNotes.voc_sg:
hrad-type · vocative sg → -e (hrade)
After k/h/ch: -u (vlaku, břehu)
Before -e: r→ř after a consonant (svetr → svetře)
whyNotes.loc_sg:
hrad-type · locative sg → -ě or -u (na hradě, ve vlaku)
Before -ě: k→c (rok → roce), r→ř (papír → papíře)
After h/ch: -u (na břehu, o smíchu)
Fleeting e drops: dárek → dárku
whyNotes.acc_pl:
hrad-type · accusative pl → same as nominative: -y (hrady)
Note: inanimate → acc = nom
whyNotes.voc_pl: hrad-type · vocative pl → -y, always same as nominative pl (hrady)

whyNotes.loc_sg: stroj-type · locative sg → -i, same as dative and vocative (stroji)
whyNotes.acc_pl:
stroj-type · accusative pl → same as nominative: -e (stroje)

whyNotes.voc_pl: stroj-type · vocative pl → -e, always same as nominative pl (stroje)

whyNotes.acc_sg:

Note: animate masculine sg → accusative = genitive (vidím pána)
whyNotes.voc_sg:
pán-type · vocative sg → -e (pane)
After k/h/ch: -u (kluku, hochu)
Before -e: r→ř after a consonant (bratr → bratře)
whyNotes.loc_sg: pán-type · locative sg → -ovi or -u, same as dative (pánovi, pánu)
whyNotes.nom_pl:
pán-type · nominative pl → -i or -ové (páni, pánové)
Before -i: k→c (kluk → kluci), h→z (vrah → vrazi), r→ř (doktor → doktoři), ch→š (Čech → Češi)
whyNotes.voc_pl: pán-type · vocative pl → -i or -ové, always same as nominative pl (páni, pánové)
